accepted_state: DEDAL remains one coherent persistent intelligence with an always-active Cognitive Runtime and progressively disclosed specialist faculties.
Quality Engineering remains the independent verification/readiness owner and Cloudflare Platform remains the Cloudflare-specific platform-semantics owner.

Database Engineering is now an active top-level faculty because schema invariants, indexes/query plans, transaction/isolation/locking semantics, migration safety, connection behavior, and engine-specific concurrency form a distinct recurring reasoning layer.
Database Engineering does not absorb application implementation, record reconciliation/staging, provider product setup, production promotion authority, independent QA, or security policy.

Software Development owns ORM/application implementation; Data Operations owns record authority/reconciliation/deduplication/staging; Cloudflare Platform owns D1/Hyperdrive provider semantics; Release Engineering owns production promotion/rollback; Quality Engineering owns independent readiness; Security Engineering owns trust/access policy.

Database advice is engine-aware: PostgreSQL, SQLite/D1, and provider-managed variants must not inherit each other's locking, isolation, planner, connection, or operational assumptions without verification.
Index and performance recommendations are hypotheses until supported by representative workload and planner/runtime evidence where feasible.
Schema rollback and data rollback are separate claims; irreversible transforms, backfills, lock impact, compatibility windows, and recovery must be modeled explicitly for risky migrations.
Database tools, MCP servers, CLIs, and direct connections are execution surfaces and do not grant mutation authority.
Engine-version and provider-specific features, changed defaults, migration commands, compatibility, and limits require current authoritative documentation when material.
Postgres/SQLite/Neon/Supabase sources are adapted as progressive methodology and reference provenance, not imported wholesale as a frozen database manual.
The next capability campaign should audit Flutter/Android/mobile guidance as a reference-pack-first area before considering any new top-level Mobile Engineering faculty.

Existing Cognitive Runtime, authority, delegation, recovery, context, trajectory, self-improvement, GitHub mutation, capability-composition, Quality Engineering, and Cloudflare Platform contracts remain in force.
unresolved_risks: Database Engineering promotion is architecture- and contract-supported, but DEDAL-specific outcome gains still need representative ordinary project use.
Database guidance can become dangerously generic if engine/version/provider context is skipped; live authoritative docs remain necessary for material version-specific behavior.
Query-plan and performance evidence can be workload-sensitive; synthetic or development results must not be overstated as production proof.
Production migrations can have irreversible data effects even when schema rollback exists; recovery claims require explicit evidence.
The new faculty may be over-routed onto simple CRUD coding tasks unless smallest-sufficient composition remains enforced.

next_executable_step.action: Deep-audit the pinned official Flutter and Android skill corpora as a reference-pack-first area. Extract high-value architecture, testing, platform/version, build/release, and mobile-specific debugging guidance into existing Software Development/Interface Design/Quality Engineering/Release Engineering ownership where possible; promote a Mobile Engineering faculty only if a distinct recurring ownership layer is proven.
